launcher: Fixed Windows builds with your own MSYS2, set with the COLO_MSYS2_ROOT environment variable, looking for the game's compiler in a folder that MSYS2 doesn't have.
New launcher background: a painted copper engine out in the desert.
Game updates and rebuilds are much faster: the launcher keeps what it compiled and reuses it. Free up space under Settings, Manage game clears it.
Import a Dolphin save: drop your North American .gci save on the Saves tab, or the folder it is in, and carry on from there. Your current saves are backed up first.
Join our Discord server: the Discord button at the top of the launcher opens the invite in your browser.

changes: The first build of the game is faster too.
Fixed the game stopping on macOS when you arrive in Phenac City with HD textures at the highest resolution.

launcher: First release: set up and play the Pokémon Colosseum PC port from your own North American disc on Windows, macOS and Linux.
Three-step setup downloads everything it needs and builds the game on your computer. The disc image never leaves it.
HD textures: all 7,498 of the game's textures upscaled 4×, on by default. Turn them off under Settings, Graphics.
Settings for the screen format, frame rate, picture sharpness, controls, rumble and GameCube controller adapters.
Your saves are backed up before and after you play. Restore one from the Saves tab.

changes: Native PC port with movies, music and sound, HD text, widescreen, 60 fps and Vulkan or OpenGL rendering.
